verdict.rationale: The only performance evidence is the pricing page's generic claim of "fast, relevant search" for the open-source library, alongside full-text search and typo tolerance, which help with partial queries. Nothing in the pack documents millisecond latency, prefix or as-you-type matching, or per-keystroke update patterns. Missing for 10: documented latency figures or benchmarks, explicit as-you-type/prefix search documentation, per-keystroke integration guidance, independent hands-on corroboration of speed.
